g.text: A capacitor stores electric-field energy between oppositely charged plates

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal linear capacitor with passive current reference entering the positive terminal. Parallel plates: C=εA/d neglecting fringing. Electric field stores
energy; an ideal capacitor does not dissipate it. q is charge on the positive-reference plate.
